Aktuální operační plán zimní údržby, relevantní pro plnění Veřejné zakázky, bude vydán a poskytnut v souladu se závaznými právními předpisy a závazným návrhem rámcové dohody, který tvoří přílohu č. 1 Zadávací dokumentace. title: France – Architectural services for buildings – Concours de maitrise d'oeuvre pour la restructuration-extension des tours C &amp; D en vue de la réorganisation des activités &quot;maladies chroniques&quot;
description: Le présent projet concerne la réhabilitation-extension d'un bâtiment recevant du public de type U et l'isolation thermique par l'extérieur d'un bâtiment recevant du public de type U, ainsi que le traitement esthétique des façades des tours A, B, C et D du bâtiment Caremeau Nord. La réhabilitation-extension du bâtiment concerne les bâtiments C et D situés sur le site principal à Carémeau Nord. Ces bâtiments présentent aujourd'hui des conditions d'accueil hôtelières ne répondant pas aux standards attendus en milieu sanitaire. Cette opération vise les objectifs suivants : - Améliorer le confort hôtelier avec un taux de chambres individuelles supérieur à 66%, - Rendre toutes les chambres accessibles PMR, - Optimiser le capacitaire en tendant vers 24 lits d'hospitalisation complète par service. Cette opération est l'occasion de regrouper dans un même ensemble bâtimentaire les services de médecine traitant les maladies chroniques, notamment : les maladies métaboliques et endocriniennes (MME), la médecine interne, et la rhumatologie. Cette opération vise par ailleurs les objectifs fonctionnels suivants : - Réhabiliter 4 unités d'hospitalisation au maximum « standardisées » (R+2 et R+3 des tours C et D), - Regrouper les locaux tertiaires liés aux services concernés par l'opération dans la surélévation de la tour C à créer - L'isolation thermique par l'extérieur (ITE) et le ravalement des façades des tours A, B, C et D de Carémeau Nord. De plus, la réalisation des travaux est envisagée en site occupé avec maintien de l'activité en utilisant le niveau 3 de ces bâtiments, qui est aujourd'hui vide, en opération tiroir. Une note descriptive du programme est jointe au présent dossier de consultation. L'enveloppe prévisionnelle des travaux est estimée à 11 000 000 euro(s) HT. La présente consultation a donc pour objet de conclure un marché de maîtrise d'oeuvre pour une opération de restructuration-extension, avec les éléments de mission suivants : DIAG, APS, APD, PRO, ACT, EXE partielles, VISA, DET et AOR. Mission complémentaire : SSI. L'équipe de maîtrise d'oeuvre sera composée au minimum des compétences intégrées ou associées suivantes avec un mandataire du groupement : - Architecte Diplômé par le Gouvernement (DPLG) ou Habilité à exercer la Maîtrise d'oeuvre en son nom Propre (HMONP) (mandataire) - Bureau(x) d'étude(s) technique(s) compétent(s) dans les domaines suivants : Structure, Fluide/thermique, VRD, Économiste de la construction, CFO/CFA, étant précisé en cas de groupement que l'un des membres peut réunir plusieurs compétences.. La durée globale prévisionnelle d'exécution du marché de maîtrise d'oeuvre, incluant les éléments de mission réalisés pendant l'année de parfait achèvement et d'éventuelles missions complémentaires postérieures est estimée à 45 mois

description: Предмет на настоящата обществена поръчка е изпълнение на строително-монтажни работи за обект „ Корекция на река Бели Осъм и изграждане на зони за обществено ползване в участъка от моста при „Витекс“ до моста при Централен кооперативен пазар в гр. Троян“, във връзка с реализация на концепция за интегрирани териториални инвестиции (КИТИ) „Заедно за интегрирано териториално развитие на териториите по поречието на река „Осъм“ и нейните протоци“ с водещ партньор Община Троян, определена за конкретен бенефициент по процедура чрез директно предоставяне на безвъзмездна финансова помощ BG16FFPR003-2.002 „Подкрепа за интегрирано градско развитие в 40 градски общини“ на Програма „Развитие на регионите“ 2021-2027 г. и процедура № BG16FFPR002-4.006 „Природосъобразни мерки за превенция и управление на риска от наводнения“ по Приоритет 4 „Риск и изменение на климата” на Програма „Околна среда“ 2021-2027 г. С настоящата обществена поръчка се възлага извършването на изпълнение на строително-монтажни работи по почистване и укрепване на река Бели Осъм и изграждане на зони за обществено ползване в участъка от моста при „Витекс“ до моста при Централен кооперативен пазар в гр. Троян. Предметът на поръчката включва изпълнение на строителство, изготвяне на съпътстваща документация и всички необходими дейности до окончателното приемане на обекта на строителството от Възложителя по реда и условията на Наредба №3 от 31.07.2003 г. за съставяне на актове и протоколи по време на строителството и въвеждане в експлоатация. Проектът в гр. Троян обхваща участък с дължина около 1200 м и предвижда следните основни дейности, разделени на две направления: Корекция и укрепване на брега (Дейност 1) - финансирана по Програма „Околна среда 2021-2027 г.”: Включва почистване на речното легло от растителност, както и укрепване на бреговете чрез комбинация от „зелени“ и „сиво-зелени“ мерки Община Троян (заскаляване, геоклетки, биорогозки и др.). Възстановяване на дънен праг за стабилизиране на речното дъно и рибен проход; Благоустрояване на зони за отдих (Дейност 2) – финансирана по Програма „Развитие на регионите“ 2021-2027 г. и Община Троян: Изграждане на крайбрежна алея, свързваща пет различни зони, в които са предвидени - амфитеатър и пластична каскада със стълби; спортни и игрови площадки; кей-платформа за риболовци; изграждане на нова канализационна помпена станция за спиране на свободното изливане на отпадъчни води в реката; цялостно парково и художествено осветление, както и система за видеонаблюдение.​​​​​​​​​​​​​ Категория на строежа - I-ва категория, съгласно чл. 137, ал.1, т.1 от ЗУТ.

Известяване (регистриране) на почасовите графици в MMS на Енергийния системен оператор (ЕСО) както и извършване на всички необходими дейности, свързани с участието на Възложителя на свободния пазар на електрическа енергия, съгласно ПТЕЕ, ЗЕ и ПИКЕЕ.

title: Draft Fair Opportunity Proposal Request (FOPR)
description: The Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center (AFNWC/NDKE) is issuing a Fair Opportunity Proposal Request (FOPR) in accordance with FAR Part 16 for the B-52 Nuclear Stores Interface Unit (NSIU) Follow-on Production effort. This acquisition is restricted to, and will be posted directly to, the Eglin Wide Agile Acquisition Contract (EWAAC) IDIQ portal. The NSIU is a nuclear-hardened, Line-Replaceable Unit (LRU) assembly designed to support the weapon system interface, consisting of printed wiring assemblies (PWAs), interconnects, and chassis. The scope of this effort encompasses a build-to-design manufacturing and production of NSIUs in accordance with the Government-furnished Technical Data Package (TDP). Requirements will include: Hardware Manufacturing, Electronic Assembly, and Production Program Management & Systems Engineering Quality Assurance & Production Testing Data & Security Management Associated logistics support necessary to deliver flight-ready hardware Acquisition Details Contract Type: Predominantly Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) Anticipated Award: 2nd Quarter, Calendar Year 2027 The complete FOPR package, proposal submission instructions, and evaluation criteria will be released to EWAAC holders via the EWAAC IDIQ Portal. Draft documents are included with this announcement. A DD Form 2345 is required to obtain FOPR package. This announcement is cross posted with EWAAC Portal

The Government reserves the right to require a Pitch in lieu of a white paper. An evaluation panel will then select, IAW section 3 and Attachment 6 of this CSO, the white paper(s) that best meets the Government�s desire for solutions to its stated AOI. 1.5.2 Step 2: Selected offerors will be invited to submit full proposals based on favorable evaluation results of White Papers. Proposals will be requested via a Request for Proposal (RFP) letter by the contracting officer, and will contain separate submission instructions and applicable due dates and timelines. Proposals are not required until RFP has been sent. The proposals will include information/formatting IAW attachments 3-5, and be evaluated IAW section 4 and Attachment 6 of this CSO and as specified in the RFP. 1.5.2.1 Unsuccessful offerors will be notified by the Government, either via email or letter, to inform them that the proposed effort is not of interest to the Government at this time. Offerors are encouraged to complete the Annual Representations and Certification in the System for Award Management (SAM) at https://sam.gov as soon as possible. To be considered for award, offerors must be registered in the SAM, be considered responsible within the meaning of RFO Subpart 9.1, �Responsible Prospective Contractors,� have a satisfactory performance record, and otherwise be eligible for award based on federal law and regulation. 1.7 AVAILABILITY OF FUNDS: 374 CONS intends to fund successful efforts in Fiscal Year 2028 (FY28) or later date. Exceptions may be considered for individual projects based on operational need. All awards are subject to the availability of funds. 1.8 ANTICIPATED NUMBER OF AWARDS: The DAF does not have an anticipated number of awards per year for this announcement. title: Rekonstrukce objektu Liberecká 3367/35, Jablonec nad Nisou na městské byty - projektová dokumentace pro provádění stavby
description: Předmětem plnění veřejné zakázky je zpracování projektové dokumentace pro provádění stavby (dále jen „DPS“) včetně soupisu prací, dodávek a služeb s výkazem výměr (dále jen “soupis prací“) a oceněného soupisu prací, dodávek a služeb s výkazem výměr (dále jen „rozpočtu“) v souladu se Standardy služeb architekta a jeho dokumentace pro navrhování staveb vydané ČKA doplněná o náležitosti dokumentace pro zadání veřejné zakázky na stavební práce dle vyhl. č. 169/2016 na akci „Rekonstrukce objektu Liberecká 3367/35, Jablonec nad Nisou na městské byty“, která bude sloužit nejen k provádění stavby, ale i k výběru zhotovitele vlastní stavby. Projekt Liberecká 3367/35, Jablonec nad Nisou má podanou žádost o spolufinancování z Integrovaného regionálního operačního programu (IROP) a proto je nezbytně nutné, aby: DPS byla zpracována v souladu s aktuální metodikou 115. Výzvy IROP – SOCIÁLNÍ BYDLENÍ II. KPSV+-SC 4.2 (MRR), zejména pokud se jedná o Specifická pravidla pro žadatele a příjemce. Dokumenty k vyhlášenému dotačnímu programu jsou na: https://irop.gov.cz/cs/vyzvy-2021-2027/vyzvy/115vyzvairop. Jedná se o stavební úpravy bývalé ubytovny Neptun za účelem změny užívání části objektu na městské byty. Cílem projektu je přizpůsobit stávající budovu současným požadavkům na bydlení a vytvořit bytové jednotky odpovídající potřebám sociálního bydlení při zachování stávající nosné konstrukce objektu. PROHLÍDKA MÍSTA PLNĚNÍ: Zadavatelem organizovaná prohlídka místa plnění se uskuteční dne 06.11.2026 v 10:00 hodin, sraz je před vstupem do objektu z ulice Liberecká, čp.3367/35, Jablonec nad Nisou

title: Ultraäänilaitteet
description: Tuomi Logistiikka Oy perustaa dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän (myöhemmin DPS), jonka kohteena ovat ultraäänilaitteet Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen käyttöön. Tilaajina voivat olla Tuomi Logistiikan lisäksi Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialue. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisissä kilpailutuksissa tarkennetaan mukana olevat tilaajat sekä kilpailutettavat laitteet. Tuomi Logistiikka Oy perustaa dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän (myöhemmin DPS), jonka kohteena ovat ultraäänilaitteet Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen käyttöön. Tilaajina voivat olla Tuomi Logistiikan lisäksi Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialue. Dynaamisen hankinnan kuvaus DPS:n sisällä kilpailutetaan tilaajien tarpeen mukaan ultraäänilaitteita. Järjestelmään voi hakeutua koko järjestelmän voimassaoloajan. Järjestelmään hakeutuminen ei tarkoita suoraan osallistumista kilpailutettaviin hankintoihin, vaan tarjoajan tulee hyväksymisen jälkeen erikseen jättää tarjous avattaviin kilpailutuksiin. Hankintasopimuskohtaiset vaatimukset, kuvaukset ja muut asiakirjat ovat nähtävillä kilpailutuksen avaushetkellä dynaamiseen järjestelmään hyväksytyille toimijoille. Voimassa oleviin sopimuksiin eli jo kilpailutettuihin hankintoihin ei voi jättää tarjousta ennen kuin kilpailutus avataan uudelleen. DPS:n sisäisissä kilpailutuksissa määritellään erikseen mukana olevat tilaajat sekä kilpailutettavat laitteet ja niiden yksityiskohtaiset vaatimukset. Järjestelmässä voidaan kilpailuttaa esimerkiksi seuraavien tuotekategorioiden tuotteita: - Radiologiset ultraäänilaitteet - Gynekologiset ja obstetriset ultraäänilaitteet - Päivystys-, leikkaus-, anestesia- ja teho-osastotoiminnan ultraäänilaitteet - Pediatriset ultraäänilaitteet - Kliinisen neurofysiologian ultraäänilaitteet - Reumatologiset ultraäänilaitteet - Fysiatriset ultraäänilaitteet

title: Kahden uniikin leikkivälineen hankinta Lappeenrannan kaupungille
description: Kahden uniikin leikkivälineen hankinta Lappeenrannan kaupungille Hankinnan kohteena on kahden uniikin (tarjottuja leikkivälineitä ei ole toimitettu muualle) leikkivälineen toimittaminen asennettuna Lappeenrannan kaupungille. Hankittavat leikkivälineet tulevat Lappeenrantaan satama-alueelle. Ensimmäisen leikkivälineen teemana on "Hevonen" ja toisen leikkivälineen teemana on "Linna". Välineiden tulee mahtua kaikkine rakenneosineen ja putoamisalustoineen tarjouspyynnössä esitetyille tilavarausalueille. Tarjouspyynnöllä haetaan kahta uniikkia, ympäristöön sopivaa ja eri ikäryhmät huomioivia leikkivälinettä. Leikkivälineiden tulee olla myös keskenään yhteensopivia ulkonäöltään. Kilpailutus tehdään käänteisenä kilpailutuksena, eli ranskalaisena urakkana. Käänteisessä kilpailutuksessa hankinnan enimmäishinta on määritelty etukäteen, eli hinnoilla ei kilpailla. Tästä tulee myös termi kiinteähintainen kilpailutus. Tarjoajat siis kilpailevat yksinomaan laatutekijöillä. Hankintaa ei jaeta osiin. Tarjoajan on tarjottava molemmat leikkivälineet. Hankinnan arvo on 280 000 euroa (alv 0%). Sopimuskausi alkaa mahdollisimman pian hankintapäätöksen saatua lainvoiman. Sopimus alkaa aikaisintaan, kun molemmat osapuolet ovat allekirjoittaneet sopimuksen. Sopimus on voimassa siihen asti, kunnes leikkivälineet ovat hyväksytysti toimitettu sekä asennettu ja hyväksytysti käyttöönotettu tilaajan määrittämiin kohteisiin.,

title: API-Management-System
description:
The following objectives are to be achieved through the API Management Solution procurement project:


  1. Procure a standardized API management system that meets the requirements of all use cases across the OT-OT, OT-IT, IT-IT, and IT-Public domains. The rollout shall be carried out incrementally, starting with the OT environment and the OT-IT transition. The additional IT and IT Public Gateway environments shall be available as optional orderable extensions.
  2. The integration of web interfaces shall provide logical decoupling between requesting and source systems, while ensuring that systems are protected against unauthorized access and excessive traffic through authentication, authorization, and appropriate security mechanisms.
  3. The new partner shall support sgsw flexibly and according to operational needs, both during the implementation phase and throughout the subsequent years of operation.
  4. The IT-OT transition implemented via the API management solution shall be designed in such a way that it can be centrally deactivated, if required, using a small number of predefined steps (discrete OT environment).


A comprehensive API management solution shall be procured and implemented in phases, separated by system environment:


  • OT Environment (initial scope of supply)
  • IT-OT Transition (initial scope of supply)
  • IT Environment (option / extension without any acceptance guarantee)
  • IT Public Gateway (option / extension without any acceptance guarantee)


As part of this software procurement, the API management solution shall support scalable licensing that can grow in line with demand (flexible/tiered licensing model within the respective system environments). No hardware procurement is envisaged. The central components are described below.

title: DSP AdServer Marketing
description:
Objectifs du projet de marché public

L’objectif du présent appel d’offres consiste à évaluer, puis à acquérir, un partenaire de licence approprié pour la Google Marketing Platform (GMP) afin de mettre en place une infrastructure AdTech homogène et viable pour le marketing des CFF fondé sur les données. La priorité est accordée à la création d’une base technologique centrale permettant la planification, l’achat, le pilotage, l’optimisation et l’évaluation de mesures de marketing numérique pour diverses unités d’affaires. La mise en œuvre s’effectue dans le cadre d’une étroite collaboration entre une agence média et les CFF.


Objet du marché

Les CFF recherchent un partenaire de licence qualifié et expérimenté pour l’acquisition de la Google Marketing Platform (GMP). Le soumissionnaire fournira la licence GMP, réalisera l’implémentation technique et proposera des services d’assistance.

Cet appel d’offres porte sur la mise à disposition des licences nécessaires (Display & Video 360 et Campaign Manager 360) via un modèle de partenariat autorisé de Google et le soutien des CFF lors de l’introduction, de l’exploitation (hors mise en place de campagnes) et de l’entretien de la plate-forme.

Le partenaire à sélectionner assumera le rôle de partenaire de licence et garantira l’accès à la plate-forme ainsi que les prestations contractuelles et de facturation nécessaires. Il accompagnera également les CFF en matière de support, de conseil et de développement de l’utilisation de la plate-forme.


Lʼobjet du marché est intégralement décrit dans la documentation dʼappel dʼoffres.

title: V1297 Zürich, Erweiterung EZ Bullingerstr. 39; Building Construction Works
description:
The existing energy centre at Bullingerstrasse 39 in Zurich is to be extended by a two-storey annex comprising a basement and a ground floor. The basement will accommodate technical rooms and a pellet storage area, while the new heating plant will be located on the ground floor.

The scope of the building construction works includes, in particular, excavation support using a braced soldier pile wall, the necessary earthworks and excavation works, including open dewatering to drain slope water and rainwater, as well as foundation works involving micropiles. The contract also includes all concrete and reinforced concrete works for the floor slabs, walls and ceilings of the new building. The basement structures in contact with the ground must be constructed as a watertight structure using waterproof concrete (so-called “Yellow Tank” construction method).

title: Slamafvanding ME.04
description: Kalundborg Central Renseanlæg (herefter ”KCR”) skal udvides som en konsekvens af, at industrien i Kalundborg Kommune i de kommende år forøger sin tilledning. Udvidelsen af KCR (herefter ”Projektet”) sker både for at øge den biologiske kapacitet af anlægget, bedre styring af overløb, ny slamafvanding og fjernelse af miljøfremmede stoffer gennem tredje og fjerde renseanlæg. Projektet realiseres gennem en række udbud inden for byggeri- og anlæg, maskin- og el, systemleverandører og SRO. Kalundborg Renseanlæg A/S (”Bygherre”) har indgået en totalrådgiveraftale med Envidan A/S, som forestår teknisk rådgivning og bistand, projektering, byggeledelse og processpecialistrådgivning i forbindelse med Projektets realisering. Dette udbud omfatter en hovedentreprisekontrakt, som i hovedtræk indebærer udførelse af følgende arbejder: • Slamafvanding • Polymeranlæg • Transportøranlæg • Containerløsning for afvandet slam • Slampumper • Slamlagertank • Anlæg for teknisk vand • Trykluftanlæg • Biofilter (luftrensning) • El- og SRO-anlæg for ovenstående Bygningsarbejderne forbundet med at realisere procestrinene udbydes i et særskilt udbud. Tilbudsgiverne skal i tilbudslisten prissætte variable ydelser, herunder reguleringspriser, som kommer til anvendelse, i det omfang, der er behov for. Bygherre har overvejet, om indkøbet kan opdeles yderligere, men vurderer, at en yderligere opdeling vil indebære en række uhensigtsmæssige tekniske og juridiske grænseflader med deraf følgende risiko for forhindringer i udførelsesfasen samt afledte transaktionsomkostninger.

title: 1,5T MR skanner til Aarhus Universitetshospital, Kræftafdelingen

title: Nytt fagsystem for Garantikassen for fiskere
description: Garantikassen for fiskere ønsker å få anbud på nytt fagsystem, og viser til vedlagt konkurransegrunnlag. title: Konkurranse - Rammeavtale renovering no-dig, vannledninger inkl. kummer
description: Rammeavtalen gjelder renovering av vannledninger og kummer ved bruk av utblokking. Styrt boring, pilotrørsboring og strømperenovering inngår ikke i rammeavtalen.Formålet med rammeavtalen er å dekke behovet for renovering av vannledning , der utblokking kan benyttes som metode, samt renovering av kummer og retilknytning av private stikkledninger. I tillegg til utblokking vil det være et begrenset behov for renovering ved bruk av tradisjonell grøftegraving i tilfeller der utblokking ikke lar seg gjennomføre.Oppdragsgiver for planlegger for to avrop per år, der hvert avrop består av pakking av flere tiltak. Oppdragsgivers planlegger å renovere omtrent 3000 meter per år, og øke antall meter i løpet av kontraktsperioden. Det reelle omfanget vil likevel variere, og oppdragsgiver er ikke forpliktet til ovennevnte estimat. Rammeavtalens estimerte økonomiske ramme inkl. opsjon på forlengelse er 415 000 000,-, mens maksimal ramme er 600 000 000,-. Dette er basert på beregning av estimert pris på 3000 meter per år som kan økes til 4000 meter per år.Rammeavtalen har en varighet på 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 år.

Das gegenständliche Open-House-Modell unterliegt nicht dem Bundesvergabegesetz 2018, BGBl I Nr 65/2018 idgF. Das Open House Verfahren läuft auf unbestimmte Dauer. description: Les cuisines centrales de la Mairie de Toulouse assurent tous les repas des écoles et des foyers seniors de la ville. Construites en 1983 pour une capacité de 12 000 repas par jour, elles en assurent 36 000 aujourd'hui. Les exigences sanitaires et les besoins d'évolution de production des repas nécessitent la création d'une nouvelle cuisine centrale, adaptée et de grande capacité de production (40 000 repas par jour). Les prestations du présent marché concernent la conception et la construction d'une cuisine centrale destinée à assurer la production d'environ 40 000 repas par jour pour les besoins de la Ville de Toulouse. Ces repas sont principalement destinés aux enfants scolarisés et aux séniors. A titre indicatif le montant de l'enveloppe prévisionnelle des travaux est fixé à 26 000 000 euro(s) HT, plus ou moins 10 % (valeur octobre 2026). Cette enveloppe sera affinée en phase offre. La construction d'une cuisine centrale implique des contraintes techniques importantes et interdépendantes. Ces éléments imposent une conception intégrée et coordonnée entre le concepteur (architecte/BE) et le constructeur. Une séparation stricte entre études et travaux présenterait des risques de non-conformité, ou d'inadéquation technique. En conséquence, le recours à un marché global de type conception-réalisation, passé en application de l'article L.2171-1 et suivants et l'article R.2171-1 du Code de la commande publique, permet de répondre à l'ensemble de ces contraintes. Il s'agit d'un marché de travaux, ayant pour objet la conception de l'ouvrage et sa réalisation

description: Auf Beschluss der KMK ist für das Jahr 2028 der erste Ländervergleich zum Erreichen der weiterentwickelten Bildungsstandards für den Primarbereich vorgesehen. Dazu werden ca. 31.850 Schülerinnen und Schüler der 4. Klasse in allen 16 Bundesländern neu entwickelte digitale Kompetenztests in den Fächern Deutsch und Mathematik bearbeiten. Zudem werden den beteiligten Schülerinnen und Schülern, Lehrkräften und Schulleitungen sowie den Eltern bzw. Erziehungsberechtigten der Kinder Fragebögen vorgelegt. Der hier zu vergebende Auftrag umfasst die Vorbereitung des IQB-Bildungstrends 2028 (einschließlich der Ziehung einer bundesweit und auf Ebene der 16 Bundesländer repräsentativen Stichprobe), ihre Durchführung (Feldarbeit und Datenerhebung), die Datenerfassung und -aufbereitung, die Erstellung von Fallgewichten sowie den Versand von Schulrückmeldungen an die teilnehmenden Schulen. title: Swanley Park Footpath Refurbishment
description: Swanley Town Council is seeking suitably qualified and experienced contractors to undertake the excavation, removal, reconstruction and improvement of two existing footpaths. The project aims to improve accessibility, durability and the overall quality of the footpath network through the installation of wider, fit-for-purpose pathways that meet the requirements of their intended use. The works will comprise the following: Footpath One Footpath One extends approximately 355.4 linear metres and will broadly follow the alignment of the existing footpath. The pathway will be widened to provide a finished width of approximately 2.5 metres, excluding edging. The construction must be suitable for occasional vehicular access, with the appropriate sub-base and construction specification provided to accommodate this requirement. Footpath Two Footpath Two currently measures approximately 29 linear metres and will be extended to approximately 62.3 linear metres. The completed pathway will provide a finished width of approximately 2 metres, excluding edging, improving the provision and usability of the route. Surfacing Options and Construction Requirements The Council is currently exploring a range of surfacing options for the proposed footpaths, including self-binding gravel, tarmac and block paving. Contractors may be required to consider the suitability, durability, maintenance requirements, accessibility and whole-life costs associated with these options to help inform the Council's final decision on the preferred surfacing materials. The appointed contractor will be expected to undertake the necessary excavation and removal of existing footpath materials, prepare the underlying formation, install an appropriate sub-base and construct the new footpaths in accordance with the agreed specification. The works will also include suitable edging, finishing details and any associated reinstatement required to leave the completed pathways in a safe, stable and serviceable condition. All works must be carried out to an appropriate professional standard, with due consideration given to site conditions, public safety, drainage, accessibility and the long-term performance of the finished surfaces. The contractor will be responsible for ensuring that the construction methods and materials used are suitable for the intended use of each footpath. The Council is seeking a cost-effective and durable solution that provides improved pedestrian routes, meets the operational requirements of the site and offers good long-term value for money. Arrange for a site visit if required by contacting (George) gbrooker@swanleytowncouncil.gov.uk Apply by sending your quote to (Ryan) rhayman@swanleytowncouncil.gov.uk

title: Managed Detection and Response (MDR)
description: Med henblik på at beskytte Statens IT (Ordregiver) mod aktuelle og fremtidige cybertrusler anvender Ordregiver en række sikkerhedsteknologier, herunder en Extended Detection and Response (XDR)-platform. XDR-platformen understøtter indsamling, korrelation og analyse af sikkerhedsrelaterede hændelser på tværs af Ordregivers it-miljø med henblik på at beskytte systemer, tjenester og data samt sikre dataenes fortrolighed, integritet og tilgængelighed. Henset hertil udbyder Ordregiver en kontrakt, hvis formål er at understøtte og styrke Ordregivers egen operative it-sikkerhed gennem levering af en Managed Detection and Response (MDR)-tjeneste fra et Security Operations Center (SOC). MDR-tjenesten skal anvende og supplere Ordregivers XDR-platform med døgnbemandet overvågning, analyse, detektion, validering, eskalering og håndtering af sikkerhedshændelser. Tjenesten skal leveres 24 timer i døgnet, 365 dage om året, og bidrage til hurtig identifikation, vurdering og håndtering af cybertrusler og sikkerhedshændelser. Tjenesteydelserne udgør et væsentligt element i Ordregivers fortsatte modnings- og udviklingsproces på cybersikkerhedsområdet med fokus på teknologi, processer, kompetencer og samarbejde på tværs af interne og eksterne interessenter. Med udbuddet ønsker Ordregiver adgang til en professionel MDR-tjeneste, der kan imødekomme Ordregivers høje krav til kvalitet, robusthed og effektivitet, samt en leverandør, der løbende kan indgå i dialog med Ordregiver om udviklingen inden for cybersikkerhed, herunder trusselsbilledet, teknologiske muligheder, automatisering, kompetenceudvikling og løbende forbedringer af sikkerhedsniveauet. Leverandøren skal gennemføre en teknisk, organisatorisk og processuel Transition Ind, der sikrer, at de løbende MDR-ydelser kan leveres fra overgang til driftsfasen. Ordregiver gør opmærksom på, at Ordregiver har indgået kontrakt med to (2) leverandører til varetagelse af Ordregivers eksisterende XDR-platform, som leverandøren skal samarbejde med i forbindelse med Transition Ind. Som led heri skal leverandøren etablere og konfigurere de nødvendige integrationer mellem Ordregivers XDR-platform og øvrige relevante sikkerhedskilder samt leverandørens værktøjer og platforme, der anvendes til kontraktens opfyldelse. Leverandøren skal levere Løbende MDR-ydelser; herunder kontinuerlig overvågning, analyse, korrelation, validering og detektion af alarmer og sikkerhedshændelser. Leverandøren skal foretage triagering og kvalificering af alarmer med henblik på at identificere reelle sikkerhedshændelser samt sikre rettidig eskalering og advisering i overensstemmelse med aftalte processer og serviceniveauer. Disse løbende MDR-ydelser omfatter herunder: • Kontinuerlig SOC-overvågning af sikkerhedsrelaterede hændelser og alarmer. • Analyse, korrelation og kvalificering af hændelser på tværs af relevante datakilder. • Identifikation, detektion og validering af sikkerhedshændelser. • Udarbejdelse, implementering og løbende optimering af detektionsregler, use cases og analysemodeller. • Anvendelse af relevant Threat Intelligence til understøttelse af detektions- og analysearbejdet. • Løbende vurdering af trusselsbilledet og dets relevans for Ordregivers miljø. • Proaktiv identifikation af potentielle sikkerhedshændelser og sikkerhedsrisici, herunder gennem Threat Hunting-aktiviteter. • Eskalering, advisering og rapportering af sikkerhedshændelser i henhold til aftalte processer og serviceniveauer. • Vedligeholdelse af eksisterende integrationer samt etablering af nye integrationer efter behov. • Optimering og videreudvikling af Ordregivers XDR-platform og øvrige sikkerhedsløsninger. • Rådgivning vedrørende udvikling og modning af Ordregivers sikkerhedsorganisation, sikkerhedsprocesser og governance. • Gennemførelse af målrettede Threat Hunting-forløb og analyser af mistænkelige aktiviteter. • Incident Response-bistand ved sikkerhedshændelser efter rekvisition fra Ordregiver, herunder analyse, afgrænsning, håndtering, afhjælpning og genopretning. • Bistand ved større sikkerhedshændelser, cyberkriser og koordination med relevante interessenter. • Sikkerhedsfaglig rådgivning og strategisk sparring om udviklingen inden for cybersikkerhed. Kontrakten omfatter desuden tværgående ydelser, herunder dokumentation, rapportering, governance, kvalitetssikring og informationssikkerhed, der leveres gennem hele kontraktperioden. Endvidere omfatter kontrakten forpligtelser ved kontraktophør (Transition Ud), der skal sikre en kontrolleret, sikker og dokumenteret overdragelse af viden, data, processer, integrationer og øvrige kontraktrelaterede leverancer til Ordregiver eller en efterfølgende leverandør.

title: Actuarial Costing and Return on Investment Analysis for the Modernization of the Federal Workers’ Compensation Regime
description: The purpose of this requirement is to obtain an independent actuarial costing analysis of the short-, medium- and long-term direct and indirect costs if the current federal workers’ compensation regime remains unchanged, or if two options for modernizing the regime are implemented. The analysis must include both overall costs of the regime, and costs for (a) the five federal employers with the highest volumes of workers’ compensation claims and (b) a selection of federal employers with moderate claim volumes. The analysis should also provide a return on investment (ROI) for the two modernization options.

title: APN - NORAD Northern Basing Infrastructure (NNBI), NWT
description: Advance Procurement Notice NORAD Northern Basing Infrastructure (NNBI) Forward Operating Locations (FOL) Inuvik and Yellowknife (with Security Requirements) Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a bid solicitation. This is an advance notice of potential contracts with anticipated security requirements, providing interested design-builders with an opportunity to begin the sponsorship request process for potentially obtaining the required security clearance(s) that are anticipated. Note that there is no guarantee that these solicitations will proceed or that any security clearance(s) will be granted under the sponsorship process in a timely fashion or otherwise. Description of the Program and Services The Department of National Defence (DND) is investing in infrastructure developments for the North American Aerospace Defence Command (NORAD) Modernization and Continental Defence at the FOLs in Inuvik and Yellowknife, Northwest Territories. This infrastructure investment aims to ensure that the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) have the tools they need to achieve their security and sovereignty objectives. These improvements will enable advanced aircraft operations and quick mobilization in the North for NORAD missions. The infrastructure requirements for the Inuvik and Yellowknife FOLs will include the following but are not limited to: Airfield improvements; New and/or repurposed hangars with aprons and taxiways; Ammunition compounds; Fuel facilities; Accommodations, warehousing, planning, multi-purpose facilities, and support equipment; Robust IT, Cyber, and Logistics infrastructure.  Preliminary rough order of magnitude (ROM) estimates for the various facility components for each locations are as follows, subject to revision: Total hangar space, ~ 33,000 m2 Fuel storage, between 500,000  to 2,000,000 litres Office space  500 m2 Ammunition Storage 600 m2 Accommodations 4,000 m2 Fire Hall 2,000 m2 Multi-purpose facilities 9,000 m2 Indoor storage (Total), 9,000 m2 Apron 122,000 m2 Total asphalt surface 72,000 m2 The delivery method for this infrastructure will be Modified Design-Build (MDB) contracts, with one MDB contract per site and an estimated total contract value that may exceed $5B for each location. These multi-year contracts consist of the following sequential and/or concurrent phases and are not limited to: Requirements validation, concept development, market analysis and planning activities. Design Phase activities. Construction Phase activities. It is anticipated that the Request for Proposal (RFP) will include detailed evaluation criteria; however, these remain subject to change and will be finalized and fully described in the RFP documentation upon release. At a high level, it is expected that the RFP will assess proponents on demonstrated experience across a range of factors, including northern design and construction experience, experience delivering similar asset types (both within and outside of northern environments), and the integration of design and construction capabilities within a single team. Key personnel requirements will include demonstrated northern experience for certain roles. The evaluation of approach and methodology is expected to consider how proponents plan to successfully deliver projects in northern environments, including logistics, climate, and constructability considerations, as well as their approach to Indigenous participation based on principles of meaningful participation and mitigation of potential adverse effects. In addition to the technical evaluation, a formal interview process will be conducted to further assess team capability to successfully deliver the project in a northern environment. The terms and conditions of the contract will allow for self-performed work by the design-build team.  The MDB solicitation for Inuvik is projected to be released in Fall 2026 and Yellowknife in Summer 2027. This is conditional on receiving approval to proceed by DND. The Government of Canada is committed to advancing reconciliation and fostering meaningful engagement with Indigenous Peoples. In support of these commitments, DND aims to create opportunities for Indigenous businesses and communities through meaningful subcontracting, employment, and training related to the proposed project. To align with these objectives, the successful proponents will be required to develop an Indigenous Benefits Plan (IBP) as part of the MDB contracts. The IBPs will outline proposed initiatives and opportunities for Indigenous participation, including subcontracting, employment, and training activities. Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements To be eligible for contract award, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the tender documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Facility Security Clearance at the level of SECRET. Industrial Security Program (ISP) Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing design-builders early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, design-builders that intend to submit a proposal on one or more of these projects and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, design-builders are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number (Project number on the MERX notice); Contract number PR24NNBI; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored for. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the design-builders to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a design-builder: has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation (s) (Contract number(s) listed on their request for sponsorship) being advertised on MERX, has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package, and has submitted a proposal. DCC will send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. description: Harrastamisen Mäntsälän malli on osa valtakunnallista opetus- ja kulttuuriministeriön tukemaa Harrastamisen Suomen mallia, jonka tavoitteena on tarjota peruskoululaisille (vuosiluokkien 1-9 oppilaat) laadukkaita, mieluisia ja maksuttomia harrastusmahdollisuuksia oman koulun ja kodin läheisyydessä, koulupäivän yhteydessä, lasten ja nuorten toiveita kuullen. Harrastuksen järjestäjinä voivat olla urheiluseurat, kulttuuritoimijat, nuorisojärjestöt, kunnat, yritykset ja muut harrastustoimintaa järjestävät yhteisöt. Harrastustoiminnan tulee olla säännöllistä, viikoittaista ja laadukasta koko lukuvuoden kestävää toimintaa, joka alkaa elokuussa ja loppuu toukokuussa. Harrastustoimintaa ei voi järjestää etänä (poikkeuksena vuosiluokkien 7-9 oppilaille suunnattu digitaalinen harrastustoiminta), vaan se tulee toteuttaa paikan päällä ja paikalla on aina oltava valvoja. Ohjaajan osaamisen tulee olla riittävä laadukkaan avoimen toiminnan järjestämiseen. Harrastusten ohjaajien tulee olla täysi-ikäisiä ja ammattimaisia omalla osaamisalueellaan sekä omata kokemusta lasten ja nuorten parissa toimimisesta. Apuohjaaja voi olla alaikäinen. Mäntsälän kunta kilpailuttaa lapsille ja nuorille suunnatun harrastustoiminnan järjestämisen aikajaksolle elokuu 2025 – toukokuu 2027. Kilpailutukset toteutetaan nyt perustettavan dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän (DPS) puitteissa kaksivaiheisesti ja sen toteutuminen on ehdollinen myönnetylle valtionavustukselle. Ensimmäisessä vaiheessa dynaamisessa hankintajärjestelmässä harrastuksen järjestäjät ilmoittautuvat mukaan järjestelmään, jolloin tarkistetaan ehdokkaan soveltuvuus. Kaikki kelpoisuus- ja vähimmäisvaatimukset täyttävät tarjoajat valitaan mukaan dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään. Osallistumishakemuksen yhteydessä ei tarjota hintoja. Dynaamisessa hankintajärjestelmässä kaikki kiinnostuneet toimittajat voivat pyytää osallistua osallistumisilmoituksen määräaikaan 30.11.2026 asti. Toisessa vaiheessa ehdokkaat voivat antaa tarjouksia tarjouskilpailuihin, jotka järjestetään dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisällä. Tarjouspyyntöjä lähetetään toimittajarekisteriin hyväksytyille tarjoajille. Tarjouksia tullaan pyytämään seuraavista osa-alueista: 1) liikunnallinen, 2) kulttuurinen ja käden taidot sekä 3) digitaalinen harrastustoiminta. Näiden osa-alueiden sisällä tullaan järjestämään tarjouspyyntöjä lukuvuosittain tai tarvittaessa lukukausittain dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän voimassa olon ajan. Tulevan lukuvuoden 2025-2026 harrastustoiminnan kilpailutuksen tavoiteaikataulun mukaan tulemme pyytämään tähän dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään hyväksytyiltä ehdokkailta tarjouksia kevään 2025 aikana 8.5.2025 saakka, kerhotoiminta alkaa elokuussa 2025. Tarkistamme mahdolliset muutostarpeet kevätlukukaudelle joulukuun aikana. Seuraavan lukuvuoden 2026-2027 harrastustarjonnan kokoaminen aloitetaan mukaan ilmoittautuneiden toimijoiden kanssa toukokuun 2026 aikana. Toimijaksi voi ilmoittautua ympäri vuoden. Osallistumishakemuksia käsitellään ensimmäisen kerran viikolla 13/2025 ja jatkossa vähintään puolivuosittain huhti- ja joulukuussa ennen uuden lukukauden alkua ja ennen tarjouspyyntöjen lähettämistä. Liikunnallinen harrastustoiminta Kilpailutus toteutetaan dynaamisena kilpailutuksena kaksivaiheisesti. Ensimmäisessä vaiheessa dynaamisessa hankintajärjestelmässä (DPS) harrastuksen järjestäjät ilmoittautuvat mukaan ko. järjestelmään. Tässä yhteydessä tarkistetaan ehdokkaan soveltuvuus. Kaikki kelpoisuus- ja vähimmäisvaatimukset täyttävät toimittajat valitaan mukaan DPS:ään. Toisessa vaiheessa ehdokkaat voivat antaa tarjouksia tarjouskilpailuihin, jotka järjestetään DPS:n sisällä. Osa numero 1: Liikunnalliset harrastustoimintapalvelut voivat olla esim. parkour, keilailu, kamppailulajit, palloilulajit (esim. jalkapallo, koripallo, salibandy, tennis), voimistelu / akrobatia / tanssi, talvilajit (esim. jääkiekko, hiihto ja luistelu) ja muu liikunnallinen harrastustoiminta. Hankintayksikkö voi kilpailuttaa tässä osa-alueessa myös muuta näihin verrattavissa olevan liikunnallisen harrastustoiminnan ohjaustunteja. Tarkemmat kohdekohtaiset tiedot määritellään myöhemmissä DPS:n sisäisissä kilpailutuksissa. Mäntsälän kunta varaa mahdollisuuden sulkea DPS tilapäisesti, esim. loma-aikoina, mikäli julkisia hankintoja koskeva lainsäädäntö sen sallii. Osa numero 2: Kulttuuristen ja käden taitojen harrastustoimintapalveluiden kohteena voivat olla esim. askartelu (käsityö), teatteri, kuvataide, katutaide, valokuvaus, elokuva, kirjallisuus, musiikki ja bänditoiminta, luonto- ja erätaidot, ensiaputaidot ja kokkikerhot . Osa numero 3: Digitaalisia harrastustoimintapalveluja voivat olla esim. digipelaaminen, pelisuunnittelu, koodaus, media ja some. title: Quantum Benchmarking Initiative Topic (QBIT) Stage A
description: The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) is issuing a Quantum Benchmarking Initiative topic (QBIT) to solicit innovative approaches addressing challenges related to quantum computing. The QBIT will examine approaches to constructing a utility-scale fault-tolerant quantum computer and computational workflows that include quantum compute steps. Proposed research should investigate approaches that enable revolutionary advances in design, engineering, testing, and evaluation of such systems. Specifically excluded is research that primarily results in evolutionary improvements to the existing state of practice. The purpose of this QBIT is to encourage new entrants to QBI, ensuring DARPA has visibility into all approaches and potential solutions. While this QBIT is not intended to solicit proposals from performers selected under prior QBI or US2QC solicitations, those performers are not precluded from submitting new proposals under this PA if they believe their approach offers new or distinct contributions to the QBI initiative. This QBIT is issued under DARPA�s Quantum Benchmarking Initiative (QBI), described in the QBI 2026 Program Announcement (PA), DARPA-PA-26-02. To view the original DARPA PA for QBI 2026, visit SAM.gov under solicitation number DARPA-PA-26-02: https://sam.gov/workspace/contract/opp/c26b38bf041a4d70b00ed619bebb4773/view

title: Request for Information (RFI) Live Television News Feed Service Delivery
description: This Request for Information is issued by The Department of National Defence (DND) for the purpose of gathering information from industry regarding capabilities and potential approaches for the delivery of one-way service delivery of live television news services to multiple end-user locations at 17 Wing, Winnipeg. DND is seeking information on available industry solutions that could satisfy the following: • Providing delivery of live television programming to up to 35x end-user locations within a series of buildings at a single CAF complex; • Providing a hybrid solution capable of conventional two-way service delivery to unclassified buildings as well as one-way service delivery in order to operate within Canadian Armed Forces Physical Security & Emissions Security (EMSEC) zones at up to 4x locations, in accordance with applicable Government of Canada security requirements; and • Providing access to local, national, and international news programming.

description: Revised Language SCOPE OF SOLICITATION The Federal Supply Schedule (FSS) program is also known as the GSA Schedules Program or the Multiple Award Schedule (MAS) Program. The FSS program is directed and managed by GSA and provides Federal agencies with a simplified process for obtaining commercial supplies and services at prices associated with volume buying. Indefinite-delivery, indefinite quantity contracts are awarded to provide supplies and services at stated prices for given periods of time. GSA has delegated authority to the VA to manage the Schedules for medical supplies under the VA FSS program. This solicitation is for the offering of reference laboratory services for the purpose of providing medical laboratory testing for the diagnosis, prevention, or treatment of a disease or condition and to assess patient health to make clinical decisions for patient care.� This solicitation is not for facilities that only collect and/or prepare specimens nor for those facilities that only serve as a mailing service and do not perform testing services. This solicitation is issued to establish contracts which may be used on a nonmandatory basis by eligible users, as a source of supply for the supplies or services described herein, for domestic. Domestic delivery is defined as delivery within the 48 contiguous states, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Washington, DC, and U.S. territories . Offerors may be limited to geographic service areas based upon licensing requirements or may offer nationwide delivery. This solicitation further requires that offered prices cover delivery to destinations (i.e. F.O.B. destination) located within the 48 contiguous states and the District of Columbia. Offerors can choose whether or not prices cover delivery f.o.b. destination to Alaska, Hawaii, and the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico. Additionally, the solicitation defines the number of calendar days after receipt of order (ARO) within which delivery must be made. Offerors who cannot provide the required minimum geographic coverage, that is one state, will not be considered for award. As specified in the solicitation, offerors shall comply with all state, federal and local regulations, licenses, permits, and accreditation necessary to manage and conduct preanalytic specimen testing services. Offerors must comply with states that require out of state licenses/permits. Therefore, laboratories conducting clinical testing on specimens originating in a state that requires an out of state license/permit must hold that state s Department of Health (or other governing body) clinical laboratory permit, licenses, etc. � Offerors that are not compliant with the originating state s licensing and/or permit requirement, regardless of location, will not be considered for an award for that specific state. Offerors may not subcontract to another laboratory to circumvent the originating state s requirement for licensing, permits, etc. The offeror, in itself, is required to meet the requirements of the solicitation without the aid of a subcontractor. The Government retains sole discretion to determine the offeror s capability, compliance, and to limit SINs or geographic coverage. Commercial Items Per GSA regulations at 538.271(a), MAS awards are for commercial items as defined in FAR 2.101. Special Item Numbers (SINs): FSS solicitations set forth broad categories of accepted products/services, referred to as Special Item Numbers (SINs), listed in the Continuation of SF1449 in Vendor Response Document 02. Offerors are not required to submit their entire catalog of products/services but are free to choose which items they will offer as long as those items fall within one of the solicitation s pre-defined SIN categories. Items that do not fall within one of these SINs are considered to be out of scope of the solicitation and cannot be awarded. An item s acceptability under the schedule may be further restricted by a determination of fair and reasonable pricing. Offered diagnostic testing services must be categorized under the accepted services referenced under the Special Item Numbers (SINs) and classified as a specialties or subspecialties of tests as defined under the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments of 1988 (CLIA). Please note that items offered are further restricted to those tests with CPT codes. Additionally, FSS will not award any home diagnostic tests under this schedule. Home diagnostic tests/test kits may be proposed under Schedule 65 V II Invitro Diagnostics, Reagents, Test Kits and Test Sets. FDA Regulatory Requirements Reagents used to perform the tests must be FDA cleared, as appropriate, or be identified as a Laboratory Developed Test (LDT). Offerors of tests not in compliance with these requirements shall not be considered for award under this solicitation. New Items vs. Refurbished or Grey Market Goods This solicitation is for the award of new items only. The Contractor shall provide only new equipment and new parts for the required products described herein. Absolutely no grey market goods or refurbished products shall be provided under any delivery order. Grey market goods are defined as genuine branded goods sold outside of an authorized sales-territory (or by non-authorized dealers in an authorized territory) at prices lower than being charged in authorized sales territories (or by authorized dealers). All equipment must be covered by the manufacturer s warranty. Trade Agreements Act The Trade Agreements Act is applicable to all Schedules. In exercising its authority under FAR Part 25, Foreign Acquisition, purchases by Ordering Activities are restricted to either U.S.-made or designated country end products as defined in clause FAR 52.225-5. For the purposes of this services schedule, origin is determined by the country in which the firm providing the service is established, not the location at which the services are performed. Notice of Additional Requirements - Ordering Level In addition to the terms and conditions set forth in this solicitation, the contractor may, in the performance of orders issued under this contract, be responsible for further requirements at the ordering level. For more information on these potential, additional requirements, please see the note in Solicitation Document 01 after FAR clause 52.216-18 Ordering. Please note that the VA does not promote the use of any company s specific Schedule contract. Vendors should be aware that obtaining a VA Schedule contract is not a guarantee of sales. Vendors awarded a VA Schedule contract will need to market their supplies and services to Government customers as they would to commercial customers. A listing of eligible schedule users can be found at on GSA s website at http://gsa.federalschedules.com/resources/eligible-gsa-schedule-users/. Current contract holders do not need to complete sections below: GEOGRAPHIC COVERAGE Current Coverage: List the specific U.S. states, including Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Washington D.C., and U.S. territories in which you are currently providing or have provided services relative to this solicitation in the last two years. Enter Nationwide if currently/recently providing nationwide (i.e. domestic delivery) coverage. Proposed Coverage: Offerors may propose to provide service to individual states or nationwide. Respond to each question below regarding proposed coverage. For each choice selected, you must also check the box to verify your submission of the requested supporting documentation. Please note that qualifying supporting documentation means evidence of compliance with all federal, state and local license and certification in accordance with Statement of Work, Section II General Qualifications and Sub-Factor B.1 Organization sub-paragraph (a)(b) - Organizational and Professional Staff. The awards must be for services provided relative to this solicitation in the last two years. Offering Nationwide (i.e. Domestic Delivery) Coverage? YES NO Nationwide coverage inclu

title: Q301--Reference Laboratory Testing
description: NO PROPOSALS OR QUOTATIONS ARE REQUESTED AT THIS TIME. THIS PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. THE FORMAL RFP WILL BE POSTED AT SAM.GOV UNDER THIS NOTICE NUMBER 36C24227R0003 ON OR ABOUT 10/07/2026. OFFERORS ARE ENCOURAGED TO MONITOR SAM.GOV FOR THE FORTHCOMING RFP AND SUPPORTING DOCUMENTATION. Brief Description of Services: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Network Contracting Office (NCO) 2, on behalf of Veterans Integrated Service Network (VISN) 2 South, intends to issue an RFP - Requirements Contract for comprehensive Reference Laboratory and Esoteric Testing Services. The contract will serve the VA Medical Centers listed in Appendix A. The contractor must provide everything needed to perform all required reference and esoteric laboratory testing. This includes, but is not limited to: All personnel, labor, equipment, transportation, information technology, supplies, and supervision Routine and STAT pickup and transportation of specimens from multiple VA medical facilities to the contractor s laboratory Pre-analytic processing and preservation of samples Performance of laboratory analysis as specified in the contractor s test manual and relevant standards Timely electronic and hardcopy reporting of results to ordering VA facilities, with direct system interface to the VA VistA Laboratory Information System (LIS) Consultation regarding test selection, specimen collection, result interpretation, and specimen requirements Provision of all consumables for specimen collection, preservation, and transport Maintenance of all required certifications and accreditations Compliance with HIPAA and VA information security requirements A complete Statement of Work, with all details and requirements, will be included in the final solicitation. Locations of Service (Appendix A): James J. Peters VA Medical Center VA New Jersey Healthcare System VA Hudson Valley Healthcare System VA New York Harbor Healthcare System Northport VA Medical Center Set-Aside: Unrestricted, this is not Set-Aside. NAICS: 621511 Medical Laboratories

title: Q702--Santa Maria IOTA
description: Department of Veterans Affairs Veterans Health Administration Program Contracting Activity Central (PCAC) October 13, 2026 PRESOLICITATION NOTICE Initial Outfitting, Transition, and Activation Services in support of the Santa Maria, CA OPC 100% SDVOSB SET ASIDE This is a Pre-Solicitation Notice that the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) intends to solicit quotes to provide non-personal Initial Outfitting, Transition, and Activation (IOT&A) services for the Santa Maria Outpatient Clinic (OPC). This requirement supports VHA's mission by providing contractor support services to help bring the hospital into full planned operations that will provide health care services to Veterans. This will be a firm-fixed-price contract with an estimated Period of Performance of 31-months. VHA authorized a 28,656 net usable square foot (NUSF) outpatient clinic (OPC) lease project in Santa Maria, California. The project will support the parent facility, the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Greater Los Angeles Healthcare System. The new OPC will replace the existing clinic in Santa Maria, which currently contains 28,612 NUSF. The new clinic will be able to accommodate future workload, provide ample parking (200 spaces), and will adequately support all services in a modern, efficient space. The new clinic will provide all the services offered at the existing clinic, including Primary Care, Mental Health, Audiology, Eye Clinic, Dental, Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation, Pathology and Blood Draw, Logistics, Telehealth, Business Office, Community Engagement and Reintegration, and Women's Health. This new facility is essential to accommodate the current demand of 6,634 Unique Santa Maria Veterans and the future potential demand of 7,500 Santa Maria catchment Enrollees The scope includes project support for planning, activating, outfitting, and transitioning the staff and Veterans/patients associated with the project. The scope of services includes Comprehensive Project Management, Comprehensive Interior Design, FF&E, and Space Planning Support; CONOPS and Transitioning Planning; Acquisition Support Services to include package development, Activation, Delivery, Relocation and Installation, Training, and Turnover and Post Occupancy Support for the identified project. This requirement will be set-aside 100% for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSBs) using FAR Part 12 and 37. To be eligible for an SDVOSB set aside under VA s Veterans First Contracting Program, SDVOSBs must: be verified by the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) as SDVOSB (see https://search.certifications.sba.gov/ for details) and meet the small business size standard for NAICS 541614. The solicitation is anticipated to be posted on Contract Opportunities for download on or about 30 October 2026. Potential offerors are advised that there may be truncated response time on the solicitation that will follow this Pre-Solicitation notice. Anticipated closing date of the solicitation will be 30 November 2026. Solicitation initial posting date and the closing date are subject to change as necessary. Any questions for this Pre-solicitation notice should be sent via e-mail to both Katherine.Johnson6@va.gov and Kathleen.Klotzbach@va.gov. No telephone requests/questions will be accepted. This Pre-Solicitation notice does not constitute a request for proposals. P.O.C: Katherine.Johnson@va.gov, Contract Specialist and Kathleen.Klotzbach@va.gov, Contracting Officer

PROGRAM/PROJECT OVERVIEW: The 11th Contracting Squadron (11 CONS), District of Washington, has a requirement to execute the design-build upgrades, repairs, and/or replacements to the deteriorated Electrical Switching Stations located at B18 and B168 on Joint Base Anacostia Bolling (JBAB) that includes developing a solution to establish a connection by high voltage electrical redundancy cable. title: RFP-797-FSS-04-0001-R3: 621II Medical Laboratory Testing & Analysis Services
description: Revised Language SCOPE OF SOLICITATION The Federal Supply Schedule (FSS) program is also known as the GSA Schedules Program or the Multiple Award Schedule (MAS) Program. The FSS program is directed and managed by GSA and provides Federal agencies with a simplified process for obtaining commercial supplies and services at prices associated with volume buying. Indefinite-delivery, indefinite quantity contracts are awarded to provide supplies and services at stated prices for given periods of time. GSA has delegated authority to the VA to manage the Schedules for medical supplies under the VA FSS program. This solicitation is for the offering of reference laboratory services for the purpose of providing medical laboratory testing for the diagnosis, prevention, or treatment of a disease or condition and to assess patient health to make clinical decisions for patient care.� This solicitation is not for facilities that only collect and/or prepare specimens nor for those facilities that only serve as a mailing service and do not perform testing services. This solicitation is issued to establish contracts which may be used on a nonmandatory basis by eligible users, as a source of supply for the supplies or services described herein, for domestic. Domestic delivery is defined as delivery within the 48 contiguous states, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Washington, DC, and U.S. territories . Offerors may be limited to geographic service areas based upon licensing requirements or may offer nationwide delivery. This solicitation further requires that offered prices cover delivery to destinations (i.e. F.O.B. destination) located within the 48 contiguous states and the District of Columbia. Offerors can choose whether or not prices cover delivery f.o.b. destination to Alaska, Hawaii, and the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico. Additionally, the solicitation defines the number of calendar days after receipt of order (ARO) within which delivery must be made. Offerors who cannot provide the required minimum geographic coverage, that is one state, will not be considered for award. As specified in the solicitation, offerors shall comply with all state, federal and local regulations, licenses, permits, and accreditation necessary to manage and conduct preanalytic specimen testing services. Offerors must comply with states that require out of state licenses/permits. Therefore, laboratories conducting clinical testing on specimens originating in a state that requires an out of state license/permit must hold that state s Department of Health (or other governing body) clinical laboratory permit, licenses, etc. � Offerors that are not compliant with the originating state s licensing and/or permit requirement, regardless of location, will not be considered for an award for that specific state. Offerors may not subcontract to another laboratory to circumvent the originating state s requirement for licensing, permits, etc. The offeror, in itself, is required to meet the requirements of the solicitation without the aid of a subcontractor. The Government retains sole discretion to determine the offeror s capability, compliance, and to limit SINs or geographic coverage. Commercial Items Per GSA regulations at 538.271(a), MAS awards are for commercial items as defined in FAR 2.101. Special Item Numbers (SINs): FSS solicitations set forth broad categories of accepted products/services, referred to as Special Item Numbers (SINs), listed in the Continuation of SF1449 in Vendor Response Document 02. Offerors are not required to submit their entire catalog of products/services but are free to choose which items they will offer as long as those items fall within one of the solicitation s pre-defined SIN categories. Items that do not fall within one of these SINs are considered to be out of scope of the solicitation and cannot be awarded. An item s acceptability under the schedule may be further restricted by a determination of fair and reasonable pricing. Offered diagnostic testing services must be categorized under the accepted services referenced under the Special Item Numbers (SINs) and classified as a specialties or subspecialties of tests as defined under the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments of 1988 (CLIA). Please note that items offered are further restricted to those tests with CPT codes. Additionally, FSS will not award any home diagnostic tests under this schedule. Home diagnostic tests/test kits may be proposed under Schedule 65 V II Invitro Diagnostics, Reagents, Test Kits and Test Sets. FDA Regulatory Requirements Reagents used to perform the tests must be FDA cleared, as appropriate, or be identified as a Laboratory Developed Test (LDT). Offerors of tests not in compliance with these requirements shall not be considered for award under this solicitation. New Items vs. Refurbished or Grey Market Goods This solicitation is for the award of new items only. The Contractor shall provide only new equipment and new parts for the required products described herein. Absolutely no grey market goods or refurbished products shall be provided under any delivery order. Grey market goods are defined as genuine branded goods sold outside of an authorized sales-territory (or by non-authorized dealers in an authorized territory) at prices lower than being charged in authorized sales territories (or by authorized dealers). All equipment must be covered by the manufacturer s warranty. Trade Agreements Act The Trade Agreements Act is applicable to all Schedules. In exercising its authority under FAR Part 25, Foreign Acquisition, purchases by Ordering Activities are restricted to either U.S.-made or designated country end products as defined in clause FAR 52.225-5. For the purposes of this services schedule, origin is determined by the country in which the firm providing the service is established, not the location at which the services are performed. Notice of Additional Requirements - Ordering Level In addition to the terms and conditions set forth in this solicitation, the contractor may, in the performance of orders issued under this contract, be responsible for further requirements at the ordering level. For more information on these potential, additional requirements, please see the note in Solicitation Document 01 after FAR clause 52.216-18 Ordering. Please note that the VA does not promote the use of any company s specific Schedule contract. Vendors should be aware that obtaining a VA Schedule contract is not a guarantee of sales. Vendors awarded a VA Schedule contract will need to market their supplies and services to Government customers as they would to commercial customers. A listing of eligible schedule users can be found at on GSA s website at http://gsa.federalschedules.com/resources/eligible-gsa-schedule-users/. Enter Nationwide if currently/recently providing nationwide (i.e. domestic delivery) coverage. Proposed Coverage: Offerors may propose to provide service to individual states or nationwide. title: RFP-797-FSS-04-0001-R3: 621II Medical Laboratory Testing & Analysis Services
description: Revised Language SCOPE OF SOLICITATION The Federal Supply Schedule (FSS) program is also known as the GSA Schedules Program or the Multiple Award Schedule (MAS) Program. The FSS program is directed and managed by GSA and provides Federal agencies with a simplified process for obtaining commercial supplies and services at prices associated with volume buying. Indefinite-delivery, indefinite quantity contracts are awarded to provide supplies and services at stated prices for given periods of time. GSA has delegated authority to the VA to manage the Schedules for medical supplies under the VA FSS program. This solicitation is for the offering of reference laboratory services for the purpose of providing medical laboratory testing for the diagnosis, prevention, or treatment of a disease or condition and to assess patient health to make clinical decisions for patient care.� This solicitation is not for facilities that only collect and/or prepare specimens nor for those facilities that only serve as a mailing service and do not perform testing services. This solicitation is issued to establish contracts which may be used on a nonmandatory basis by eligible users, as a source of supply for the supplies or services described herein, for domestic. Domestic delivery is defined as delivery within the 48 contiguous states, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Washington, DC, and U.S. territories . Offerors may be limited to geographic service areas based upon licensing requirements or may offer nationwide delivery. This solicitation further requires that offered prices cover delivery to destinations (i.e. F.O.B. destination) located within the 48 contiguous states and the District of Columbia. Offerors can choose whether or not prices cover delivery f.o.b. destination to Alaska, Hawaii, and the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico. Additionally, the solicitation defines the number of calendar days after receipt of order (ARO) within which delivery must be made. Offerors who cannot provide the required minimum geographic coverage, that is one state, will not be considered for award. As specified in the solicitation, offerors shall comply with all state, federal and local regulations, licenses, permits, and accreditation necessary to manage and conduct preanalytic specimen testing services. Offerors must comply with states that require out of state licenses/permits. Therefore, laboratories conducting clinical testing on specimens originating in a state that requires an out of state license/permit must hold that state s Department of Health (or other governing body) clinical laboratory permit, licenses, etc. � Offerors that are not compliant with the originating state s licensing and/or permit requirement, regardless of location, will not be considered for an award for that specific state. Offerors may not subcontract to another laboratory to circumvent the originating state s requirement for licensing, permits, etc. The offeror, in itself, is required to meet the requirements of the solicitation without the aid of a subcontractor. The Government retains sole discretion to determine the offeror s capability, compliance, and to limit SINs or geographic coverage. Commercial Items Per GSA regulations at 538.271(a), MAS awards are for commercial items as defined in FAR 2.101. Special Item Numbers (SINs): FSS solicitations set forth broad categories of accepted products/services, referred to as Special Item Numbers (SINs), listed in the Continuation of SF1449 in Vendor Response Document 02. Offerors are not required to submit their entire catalog of products/services but are free to choose which items they will offer as long as those items fall within one of the solicitation s pre-defined SIN categories. Items that do not fall within one of these SINs are considered to be out of scope of the solicitation and cannot be awarded. An item s acceptability under the schedule may be further restricted by a determination of fair and reasonable pricing. Offered diagnostic testing services must be categorized under the accepted services referenced under the Special Item Numbers (SINs) and classified as a specialties or subspecialties of tests as defined under the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments of 1988 (CLIA). Please note that items offered are further restricted to those tests with CPT codes. Additionally, FSS will not award any home diagnostic tests under this schedule. Home diagnostic tests/test kits may be proposed under Schedule 65 V II Invitro Diagnostics, Reagents, Test Kits and Test Sets. FDA Regulatory Requirements Reagents used to perform the tests must be FDA cleared, as appropriate, or be identified as a Laboratory Developed Test (LDT). Offerors of tests not in compliance with these requirements shall not be considered for award under this solicitation. New Items vs. Refurbished or Grey Market Goods This solicitation is for the award of new items only. The Contractor shall provide only new equipment and new parts for the required products described herein. Absolutely no grey market goods or refurbished products shall be provided under any delivery order. Grey market goods are defined as genuine branded goods sold outside of an authorized sales-territory (or by non-authorized dealers in an authorized territory) at prices lower than being charged in authorized sales territories (or by authorized dealers). All equipment must be covered by the manufacturer s warranty. Trade Agreements Act The Trade Agreements Act is applicable to all Schedules. In exercising its authority under FAR Part 25, Foreign Acquisition, purchases by Ordering Activities are restricted to either U.S.-made or designated country end products as defined in clause FAR 52.225-5. For the purposes of this services schedule, origin is determined by the country in which the firm providing the service is established, not the location at which the services are performed. Notice of Additional Requirements - Ordering Level In addition to the terms and conditions set forth in this solicitation, the contractor may, in the performance of orders issued under this contract, be responsible for further requirements at the ordering level. For more information on these potential, additional requirements, please see the note in Solicitation Document 01 after FAR clause 52.216-18 Ordering.
